what: Existing launcher append path is not reconciled with caller-owned --stderr-sink logging
scenario_or_breakage: A failed brainstorm launch can append a generic review Step 2 issue, then design-step1d5.sh --mode collect appends the same failure from the canonical sink
suggested_fix: Require --stderr-sink brainstorm launches to write the sink but skip append_launch_failure, or otherwise mark the sink path as caller-owned logging while preserving no-sink behavior

what: Per-slot non-OK logging lacks a non-empty evidence-file contract
scenario_or_breakage: For EMPTY_OUTPUT or SENTINEL_TIMEOUT, REVIEWER_FILE can be empty or missing, so run-log append-failure can record little or no failure evidence
suggested_fix: Compose a per-slot collector failure log from the full collector record plus available diag, preferably via python/cli.py agent compose-collector-failure-log, and append that file once per sentinel

what: [SCOPE-REDUCTION] Proposed repeated --redact <value> passthrough adds a wrapper surface that run-log append-failure does not support
scenario_or_breakage: If a call site forwards a redact value, append-failure rejects the argv and the override warning can be silently lost behind degraded error handling
suggested_fix: Keep the minimum change: do not add valued redact args. Pass the existing boolean --redact only
